Run 2: Incorrect phrase: “孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。” Formula: Time + Subject + 跟 + Person + Verb + 了 + Object Correct: “孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬了家。” You can also emphasize how young he was: “孟子才五岁就跟妈妈搬了家。” (才 + age + 就 + action)
